owner: Canonical Portal V2 page shell and BusinessInput
issue: Uploaded CSV/XLSX source was saved with verified semantic business purpose but only import dialog/history showed it; relevant portal pages did not expose the actual raw rows.
root_cause: The original semantic import implemented a persistence write and record list, not a tenant-bound read projection within existing destination pages. As a result users could not use or verify the imported data where it belongs.
prevention_rule: Every confirmed import must project real stored table cells on its reviewed existing business page and central Data & AI source catalog; no fake KPI mapping. View must immediately drop old content on logout or invalid state and prohibit cross-tenant leakage. Use original router and read-only state, never a parallel writer.

evidence.negative_test: Cross-tenant, demo, unauthenticated, bad persistence data, invalid route and unreviewed-old-data fail closed.
evidence.positive_test: Real saved CSV rows, exact destination page, central catalog, source provenance, column headers, pagination, search and logout cleanup.

architecture.writer: No change to domainState.patch/flush and BusinessInput/ONE BRAIN

gates: authenticated real file import and tenant state readback
